notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional Islands.
You control at least two additional permanents that enter the battlefield untapped and can collectively tap to produce at least {2} if the two additional Islands enter the battlefield tapped.
description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {12}{G}{U}, creating four token copies of Mystic Sanctuary, Commander's Sphere, and two other permanents that enter the battlefield untapped and can collectively tap to produce at least {2}.
When the Mystic Sanctuary tokens enter the battlefield untapped, they trigger, putting Doppelgang on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate a Commander's Sphere token's second ability by sacrificing it, causing you to draw Doppelgang.
Activate the four Mystic Sanctuary tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate the three Commander's Sphere tokens' first abilities by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Activate seven of the other permanent tokens created in step 1 by tapping them, adding at least {7}.
Repeat.
